insight: Founded by ex-Palantir engineers and an ex-Spotify/Acast exec; $3M seed (YC-backed) with ElevenLabs among its investors.
name: Wondercraft
tagline: AI audio studio that turns ideas into produced podcasts and audiobooks.
description: Wondercraft is a browser-based AI audio studio that turns ideas, documents, or URLs into fully produced audio — podcasts, audiobooks, and ads — complete with scripts, natural-sounding voices, music, and sound effects. It offers hundreds of AI voices across dozens of languages plus voice cloning, with a timeline editor for assembling and revising episodes. Free for individuals, with paid creator and business tiers.

modelSupport.notes: Layers LLM scripting over a library of hundreds of AI voices across many languages.

edge: Assembles a finished podcast — script, AI voices, music and SFX — from a doc or URL, not just plain text-to-speech.
pros: Hundreds of voices, dozens of languages
cons: Pricier than raw TTS at scale
